title: Fibre rings of a Noetherian algebra are Noetherian
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings with $B$ Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $\mathfrak p\subset A$ be a prime ideal with residue field $\kappa(\mathfrak p)=A_{\mathfrak p}/\mathfrak pA_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Then the fibre ring $B\otimes_A\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ is Noetherian.
